subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: How seasons affect animals: hibernation, migration and nesting; sheep shearing demonstration

show.line: Some birds fly away for winter. Some animals sleep all winter. That is hibernation!

rounds.prompt: Birds fly to warmer places. That is called?
Birds build nests in which season?
What do we get when sheep are sheared?
Which season do farmers harvest mielies?

hints: Migration means moving. Hibernation means long sleep.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A bear in winter...
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bears sleep all winter.

parent_line: Knows how seasons affect animals: migration, hibernation and nesting.
